proposed_goal.title: Actual fixed and successor audit consumers participate in public build identity
proposed_goal.origin: The formal invocation test consumes20261011-host-fixed/run_audit.py and the output-exclusive test consumes its launcher, but neither is in release_identity.AUDIT_INPUTS. The reviewed short-root invocation patch would add another unlisted consumed runner. source_inputs does not recursively scan build. A runner's separate audit snapshot does not add these dependencies to public build_subject. Replaying the unchanged existing public identity test for all three paths produced three actual missing-input assertion failures in inputbind-red-20261012.xml.
proposed_goal.required_behavior: Preserve every prior AUDIT_INPUTS entry and append exactly the actual fixed runner, actual fixed launcher and newly consumed short-root runner. Extend the existing explicit membership and public build-identity parameter coverage without replacing its body or assertions. Each complete consumed source file must have its fresh exact hash and length in source_inputs; changing its read-boundary bytes must change build_subject, and restoring the observation must restore the subject without modifying the real file. Keep snapshot/run identity and public build identity distinct; do not use one to fill an omitted dependency in the other.
required_evidence: Retain the current-source RED XML SHAe74398cac64126113d1e3f84a2124aa88a6b82db248aa2f422bfdf8fea2d3685 and caller source SHA9bbba3287c9311e86375dc4443af0ea77dbe60ee7c3b4ff31ca57160e86bb6f7. The existing test body was directly called; no audit, native shell or camera was executed.

Independently review the unapplied update_consumed_inputs_after_freeze.patch SHA076b96776eb450191204e4bbd608750fb5f21ffec5cb1a8632cabe0e52e15a5e and preserve every historical input and test parameter. Apply only after original230/655e diagnostics are complete or explicitly retained unresolved.

After actual formal application, rerun the existing membership test and all old/new public build identity cases; then rerun the actual invocation coverage and complete applicable candidate audit with fresh new input hashes. Drafts or the old failed audit cannot be used as a GREEN result for the applied source.

Append this APPLICABLE/NOT_RUN/false/empty-reference goal and seed after the frozen audit boundary, preserving all prior goals and pending548-551. No package, installation authority or actual menu/boot/withdrawal qualification is granted.
